question: Does every PDF a census-v1 family declares in reports/rendered-artifacts.json actually exist on disk?
why: A missing participant deliverable survived every completeness counter, because those counters never read the companion. The Ohio BCI request was absent while four packet components declared it and the instructions said it was included unchanged. This asks the same question of all 190 families at once.
boundsTheBlastRadius: The integration that dropped these excluded fifty-nine incoming files as corpus binaries. Exactly two were packet deliverables. One is restored; this names the one that is not.
whatThisDoesNotEstablish: Presence is not correctness. A file that exists may still be the wrong document, the wrong revision, or wrongly bound. This measures existence and nothing else.
